name: SemVer Range Tester
description: Parse, compare and sort versions by SemVer 2.0.0 and check which ones satisfy an npm range
help: Precedence follows SemVer 2.0.0: pre-releases sort before releases, numeric identifiers compare as numbers (beta.2 < beta.11) and build metadata is ignored.

Ranges use npm (node-semver) semantics — comparison operators, space intersections, ||, ^, ~, x / * wildcards and hyphen ranges — and the expanded comparator sets are shown. They are not interpreted as Cargo, Maven or Python rules.
By default a pre-release only matches when a comparator with the same major.minor.patch has a pre-release; turn on Include pre-releases to compare them normally.
Invalid input is never auto-fixed: leading zeros, missing parts and overlong input get a clear reason. Copy or save the results as CSV.
